subtitle: Agent logs are deeply nested JSON

sections.heading: First Load
sections.body: The initial dlt pipeline created 78 tables from local trace files.

sections.heading: Trade-Off
sections.body: Flattening improves querying, but too much flattening creates schema pollution.

sections.heading: Adjustment
sections.body: Keeping selected fields as JSON reduced the schema to 40 tables.

sections.heading: Takeaway
sections.body: Agent observability needs both ingestion and practical schema decisions.
